title: MZ Tale of the Fabled Recurrence ( RPG Maker Game jam 2025)

posts.author: Soul_Narrative_Games
posts.body:
This game was made for the RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam.
After the conclusion of the play, "Tale of the Fabled Hero" Ellis a care-free actor is transported into the world of the play. He is the only one who knows the story is fictional, but the other actors believe they are the characters they are playing. Can Ellis escape this nightmare he found himself in, or will he be trapped, doomed to live through the events of the play forever?
A turn-based battle system where you must work with the audience to achieve victory.
Follow the story of Ellis and his two co-stars Princess Natasha and the Demon Lord
Choices you make can give you different endings
Has slight horror elements but isn't too scary
Roughly an hour worth to complete
Spoiler:
Characters
Ellis: The main character of "Tale of the Fabled Recurrence". He is chill and down to earth and cares deeply about his friends.
Natasha: She is the princess in the play. Ellis has taken part in. She is kind and passionate. Her passion leads to her acting without thinking sometimes.
Demon Lord: The antagonist of the play, Ellis has taken part in. He is cold and ruthless, trampling over others to achieve his goals.
